name: Streetwise Service Addresses
runtime: Browser JavaScript served over HTTPS or localhost
assetLocation: The lookup resolves data files beside the script. A data-address-base attribute on the script can specify another directory.

customer.input: A text input with an associated label and autocomplete=street-address
customer.attach: BlackFlagServiceAddress.mount(input, {point: savedMatch, onMatch: point => { draft.serviceAddressPoint = point; }})
customer.address: Read the normal input value when saving the request. Selection dispatches a bubbling input event.
customer.match: A match contains address, latitude, longitude and dataset. Editing the address clears the match and calls onMatch(null).
customer.fallback: Manual text entry works if a match is missing, data is unavailable, or the browser is offline.

staff.display: BlackFlagServiceAddress.mapLink(savedAddress, savedPoint) returns a coordinate-only Maps link for a matching saved record, otherwise an empty string.
staff.manualLookup: BlackFlagServiceAddress.staffLookup(container, savedAddress) provides a read-only lookup without updating the saved request.

hosting: Public address reference files can be shared by several sites on the same origin. The component does not store customer records or request device location.
